# Project instructions adapter

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), the sole project handoff. For every code task, start with [CODE_MAP_INDEX.md](../CODE_MAP_INDEX.md), follow its module/file links, and read the relevant source. After any file edit/add/delete/rename, run `pnpm codemap`. Before completion run `pnpm codemap:check`, review generated changes, and report validation. See [CODE_MAP.md](../CODE_MAP.md) for scope and commands. This adapter intentionally contains no duplicate architecture or policy.
